l1_connect_account.title: Connect the tenants that are not yet monitored
l1_connect_account.why: The tenant is in use by the business, but the platform does not read its settings or identities, so nothing in it is checked.
steps: Find the application owner and the administrator who can grant read access.
Grant a read-only integration with the least privilege the platform documents.
Confirm the first sync completed and the tenant shows users and settings.
l1_connect_account.success: Every business-owned tenant is connected and syncing.
